narration.prompt: [low, tired] My brother works nights in a hospital mortuary. I stayed with him for two nights, in the cold room. [long pause] The power cuts out all the time. Then it's black, until the generator comes back. [long pause] [quietly] The first time it came back, one of the sheets had slipped. [long pause] My brother covered it again without looking. He said, you don't look at them when the light is off. [long pause] [shaken] The third time, one of them was sitting up. By the door. The stitches down its chest had pulled open. [long pause] He said it was gas. Bodies do that. He laid it back down... and his hands were shaking. [long pause] [quietly] The second night, the generator didn't come back. I turned on my torch. [long pause] [whispers] Every covered head in that room had turned toward me. [long pause] [low] In the morning, he counted the register twice. Fourteen brought in. [short pause] Fifteen in the room.
narration.takes_note: both takes (923 credits each, 54.6 s raw); take 1 used (inner pauses capped at 0.22 s, atempo 1.03), take 2 kept

room-loop.prompt: Inside a hospital mortuary cold room at night: the steady drone of a refrigeration compressor and evaporator fans, a fluorescent tube's ballast buzzing, faint metallic ticks of cold steel, no voices, no music.

power-cut.prompt: Mains power cutting out in a building: fluorescent lights and a refrigeration compressor winding down to silence with a dying electrical whine and a clunk, then nothing.

generator-restart.prompt: An old diesel standby generator outside a building coughing, sputtering twice, then catching and roaring into a steady run, followed by fluorescent tubes clicking and flickering on with a loud electrical buzz.

generator-fails.prompt: An old diesel generator outside trying to start and failing: the starter grinding, two weak coughs, then it dies and goes silent. Distant, muffled through a wall.

sheet-slide.prompt: A heavy cotton sheet slowly sliding off a body on a steel mortuary tray and dropping to a tiled floor, close and quiet, with a soft wet thud of a limb against metal.

tray-squeal.prompt: A steel mortuary body tray squealing and grinding as weight shifts on it, a long metallic shriek then a hard clank, in a tiled cold room with reverb. Horror stinger.

sutures.prompt: Wet surgical stitches tearing open one after another, thread snapping and skin peeling apart, slow and close, gruesome horror foley.

heads-turn.prompt: In a silent dark room, many cloth sheets rustling at once as heads slowly turn under them, stiff necks creaking softly, a dozen at the same moment, then dead silence.

cold-drone.prompt: A dark ambient horror drone: cold metallic resonance like a bowed steel table, slow detuned low strings breathing underneath, frozen and sterile, no melody, no percussion.
